title: RequestLab — Free Browser-First API Workbench
description: Browser-first developer toolkit co-developed with Ashrit V: API & Socket.IO testing, load tests, request interceptor, webhooks, mock servers, flow builder, schema diffs, and AI-assisted SQL.
content:
RequestLab (requestlab.yadev.cc) was co-developed with Ashrit V in 2025. It started as a quick, zero-friction utility to compare and diff JSON responses side-by-side, and steadily grew into a comprehensive, 100% free browser-first developer workbench and testing platform.

⚡ Co-developed with Ashrit V — Live at requestlab.yadev.cc. Instant-on with zero signups required; all state, history, and collections persist locally in browser IndexedDB.

RequestLab Platform Overview — requestlab.yadev.cc

1. Multi-Tab API & Socket.IO Workbench (/api-testing)

Construct, clone, and debug complex HTTP REST requests and real-time Socket.IO streams in a tabbed workspace modeled after modern code editors. All requests auto-save to browser IndexedDB within 1,000ms. Includes integrated synthetic load-testing runs to calculate p50/p95/p99 latency distributions, plus automatic two-way cURL import/export.

Multi-tab API testing workspace with live headers, auth, parameters, and instant cURL translation

2. MySQL Schema Compare & AI Migration (/sql-compare)

Compare two MySQL database schema dumps side-by-side with semantic AST diffing that detects missing foreign keys, index drift, and column changes. Pairs with an on-device SQL analyzer and AI-assisted migration script assistant to draft zero-downtime ALTER TABLE routines.

Side-by-side MySQL database schema diffing with AI migration assistance

3. Real-Time Webhook Catching & Tunneling (/webhook)

Spin up persistent public webhook endpoints to capture, inspect, and replay incoming payloads from Stripe, GitHub, or Shopify. Built-in forwarding tunnels incoming cloud requests straight into local developer servers (http://localhost:8080/api/callback).

Webhook Receiver & Tunneling — requestlab.yadev.cc/webhook

4. Flow Builder & Split-Pane JSON Diffing (/flow-builder)

Chain multi-step API runs visually with conditional branches, delay timers, and fork/join flows on an infinite canvas, complemented by split-pane JSON formatters (/json-formatter) and side-by-side cURL comparison views (/json-compare).

title: Sparse Matrix Compression & SpMV — Research
description: Independent computer science research into a novel sparse-matrix compression format. Manuscript currently under double-blind submission embargo / academic peer review.
content:
🔒 Double-Blind Review / Pre-Publication Embargo

This manuscript is currently undergoing academic peer review under a double-blind protocol. To protect submission anonymity and prevent text-similarity flags with conference and journal indexing systems (Turnitin, iThenticate, IEEE, ACM), the architecture title, formal proofs, C++ source code, and benchmark graphs are withheld from public indexing.

Research Overview

Independent research exploring cache-efficient sparse-matrix representations for high-performance computing (HPC) and sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV).

High-Level Focus Areas

  • Contiguous Memory Packing: Investigating packed coordinate structures to minimize cache misses and indirect memory addressing.
  • Memory Footprint Optimization: Evaluating theoretical memory compression bounds against Coordinate List (COO) and Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) baselines.
  • Direct Access Mechanics: Studying constant-time direct addressing models without multi-pass binary search overhead.

Full manuscript citation and formal paper title will be published upon conclusion of peer review and formal conference/journal acceptance.

title: SuperPenTest — AI-Driven Penetration Testing Platform
description: Automated cybersecurity platform built in 3 days: powered by an LLM brain connecting Claude and OpenAI APIs to orchestrate 18 security tools, evaluate attack surfaces, and generate CVE/CVSS reports for Tricog Health.
content:
SuperPenTest was conceived and built in just 3 days at Tricog Health to answer a critical operational challenge: Can an autonomous LLM brain orchestrate security tools with the tactical judgment of an experienced penetration tester? It now powers the attack phase of Tricog's 3-phase cybersecurity audit and remediation program.

🛡️ Tricog Security Program: Powers the attack testing track alongside AI-assisted static code scanning, automated CVE/CVSS reporting, and guided team remediation across healthcare and cloud infrastructure.

1. The 3-Phase Security Architecture

Rather than relying on one-off manual audits, Tricog implemented a comprehensive 3-phase security audit and remediation track:

  • Phase 1: AI-Assisted Code Scanning: Static analysis auditing application repositories, infrastructure-as-code manifests, and API routes for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
  • Phase 2: AI-Driven Attack Testing (SuperPenTest): Dynamic attack testing where an LLM reasoning engine actively discovers exposed surfaces, probes boundaries, and simulates adversary lateral movement.
  • Phase 3: Cataloging & Remediation: Findings are classified by CVSS severity score, priority, and engineering product team, paired with actionable fix guidelines.

2. Orchestrating 18 Security Tools via API

SuperPenTest connects an LLM brain (Claude 3.5 Sonnet and OpenAI GPT-4o models via API keys) to an orchestration harness managing 18 specialized security tools: port scanners (Nmap), web vulnerability scanners, SAST scanners, DNS enumerators, SSL/TLS analyzers, and header auditors.

The LLM analyzes intermediate scan outputs in real-time. If an open port or unauthenticated endpoint is discovered, it dynamically escalates attack trees, dispatching secondary payloads tailored specifically to the detected web server or database technology.

3. Tech Stack

FastAPI (Python), React, Claude API, OpenAI API, Docker, 18 Security CLI Tools, Tailwind CSS

title: meetingBuddy — MCP-First Meeting Intelligence
description: AI-assisted meeting intelligence platform generating structured summaries, tracked action items, and conversational query interface per meeting for candidate evaluation and executive catch-ups.
content:
When action items kept slipping between busy engineering sprints and executive syncs, I built meetingBuddy at Tricog Health. Leveraging Claude and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), meetingBuddy captures raw meeting transcripts, video calls, and technical interviews, transforming them into searchable institutional knowledge.

1. Operational Capabilities

  • Automated Synthesis & Action Item Tracking: Generates concise executive summaries, timestamped decisions, and assignee-tagged action item checklists immediately upon meeting adjournment.
  • Conversational Query per Meeting: Ask complex questions against any meeting transcript: "What consensus was reached on Redis cluster eviction policies?" or "What were the architectural concerns raised for ABDM M3 integration?"
  • Candidate Evaluation Engine: Used consistently across engineering and management to score interview performance, compare candidate responses across rounds, and maintain structured hiring records (supported over 52 interviews).

2. Technical Architecture

Built with Node.js, Claude API via MCP servers, and an intuitive web UI. Transcripts and meeting artifacts are parsed into structured vector context blocks, allowing zero-latency semantic search across historic team debates and technical RFC syncs.

3. Tech Stack

Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Node.js, Web UI, Vector Indexing

title: macbar — Dynamic Island HUD for macOS
description: Transforms your MacBook's notch into an interactive Dynamic Island command center packed with live system telemetry, system-wide media controls, calendar, weather, and AirPods battery.
content:
macbar is a native macOS system utility that repurposes the static display notch cutout on modern MacBooks into an intelligent, expandable, interactive heads-up display (HUD). Instead of letting screen real estate go unused, macbar brings high-frequency system stats, media playback, calendar schedules, and hardware controls directly to your fingertips.

✨ Core Philosophy: Hover over the notch → it expands → you're in total control. Move away → it disappears seamlessly with zero cognitive overhead.

1. The Problem Space

Modern MacBook displays introduced the camera notch, creating an unused dead-zone in the menu bar. Meanwhile, power users and developers continuously juggle separate status bar icons for CPU monitoring, audio switching, weather, and media playback. Most third-party tools that attempt to address this rely on heavy web-wrapper runtimes (like Electron) that consume hundreds of megabytes of RAM and trigger significant CPU wakeups, hurting battery life.

2. Architectural & Technical Deep-Dive

macbar was engineered strictly using native SwiftUI, AppKit, and low-level Darwin / Mach kernel APIs with zero external third-party dependencies.

Window Management & Multi-Space Persistence

To ensure macbar remains instantly accessible across all virtual desktops and full-screen spaces without flickering or losing focus, NotchWindowController configures the backing NSWindow directly against the CoreGraphics window server.

Smart Two-Phase Hover Engine

A major design challenge was avoiding accidental expansions when users simply move their cursor past the top menu bar. macbar solves this using a two-phase velocity-sensitive hover tracking observer. The window only expands when the cursor enters the notch trigger zone and decelerates below a configured velocity threshold.

Live Hardware Telemetry Without Battery Drain

  • Mach Kernel CPU & RAM Polling: Directly calls host_statistics64 and vm_stat from Darwin.Mach, bypassing heavy shell invocations like top or ps.

  • Power & Battery: Reads IOKit power sources (IOPMCopyBatteryInfo) and pmset power assertion logs to track discharge velocity, cycle health, and power delivery state.

  • AirPods & Bluetooth Peripherals: Hooks into IOBluetooth to read live left/right earbud and charging case battery percentages.

  • System-Wide Media Controller: Leverages the macOS NowPlaying private framework bridge and AppleScript bridges to extract album art, track duration, scrubber progress, and Spotify/Apple Music playback controls.

3. Feature Highlights

  • 🎯 Notch-Native Geometry: Aligns perfectly with the hardware notch bezel radii across 14-inch and 16-inch Apple Silicon MacBook Pro and MacBook Air displays.

  • 📊 Interactive Stats Bar: Clickable live indicators for CPU, RAM, Free SSD Storage, Battery, and Network Wi-Fi SSID.

  • 🎵 Aesthetic Media Pill: Dynamic frosted-glass artwork blur with live playback scrubbing and tactile playback buttons.

  • 🌤️ Zero-API Weather & Calendar: Built-in weather conditions and upcoming calendar agenda without requiring paid API keys.

  • ⚡ Negligible Resource Overhead: Idle CPU usage stays below 0.2% and memory stays under 25MB.

4. Tech Stack & Tools

Swift 5.9, SwiftUI, AppKit, Combine, IOKit, IOBluetooth, CoreGraphics, Darwin Mach APIs

title: FloatMe — Zero-Latency Native macOS Presenter Camera
description: High-aesthetic, zero-latency circular floating camera preview engineered for content creators, keynote presenters, and video tutorials. Operates above full-screen apps with click-through ghost mode.
content:
FloatMe is an ultra-lightweight, perfectly circular native macOS floating camera utility designed specifically to sit gracefully over your work while screen recording, coding live, presenting slide decks, or streaming. Built strictly with Apple frameworks, it runs with near-zero CPU overhead while ensuring your webcam preview stays persistently on top of everything—even full-screen slide presentations and multi-monitor setups.

🎥 Designed for engineers and presenters who want a clean, studio-grade video circle without the bloat of OBS or heavy streaming studios.

1. The Problem Space

Presenters, educators, and engineers recording coding tutorials constantly battle clunky webcam window setups:

  • Standard camera preview windows get minimized or buried beneath full-screen Keynote/PowerPoint presentations.
  • Rectangular camera feeds block code editors, terminal prompts, and critical UI buttons.
  • Heavy software like OBS or web-based overlays consume 20-40% CPU, spin up laptop fans, and introduce perceptible audio/video latency during screen captures.

2. Key Innovations & Technical Architecture

True Floating Window Across All Spaces

FloatMe detaches from the Dock and operates as a menu-bar system agent. It elevates its window level to NSWindow.Level.screenSaver and binds to .canJoinAllSpaces:

// Setting up the zero-boundary circular presenter canvas
let window = NSWindow(
    contentRect: NSRect(x: 100, y: 100, width: circleSize, height: circleSize),
    styleMask: [.borderless],
    backing: .buffered,
    defer: false
)
window.level = .screenSaver
window.collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .stationary]
window.isOpaque = false
window.backgroundColor = .clear
window.hasShadow = true

Ghost Mode (Click-Through Event Passing)

Never get blocked by your own face again. When Ghost Mode is toggled on, mouse events are configured to ignore the floating camera window entirely, allowing clicks to strike whatever IDE button, browser tab, or presentation element lies directly underneath:

// Dynamically toggle event passing without destroying video capture buffers
window.ignoresMouseEvents = ghostModeActive

Live AVFoundation Pipeline & Edge Feathering

FloatMe connects directly to AVCaptureSession with preset .high resolution, rendering camera buffers inside a custom Metal-backed SwiftUI shape:

  • Dynamic Digital Zoom & Crop: Allows presenters to adjust digital magnification up to 300% without moving the physical laptop screen or webcam.
  • Gaussian Edge Feathering: Replaces harsh circular vector borders with a smooth, studio-fade Gaussian blur gradient.
  • Monochromatic Live Studio Filter: Real-time hardware shader that converts the live video feed into a high-contrast grayscale stream for minimalist, distraction-free technical screencasts.
  • Mirroring & Opacity Controls: Real-time horizontal flip and alpha transparency sliders stored via @AppStorage.

3. Performance Benchmarks

0.4%

Idle CPU Usage

< 18 MB

RAM Footprint

0 ms

Buffer Latency

4. Tech Stack & Frameworks

Swift 5.9, SwiftUI, AppKit, AVFoundation, CoreMedia, Metal Shaders

title: SleepX — Smart Ergonomic IoT Travel Pillow

For making naps comfortable, neck pillows exist—but managing earphones is a frustrating chore with tangled wires catching on luggage, and tiny earbud batteries die after just a few hours. Furthermore, reading books at night is impossible once overhead lights are switched off. With the aim of solving these problems, we created SleepX.

🏆

Maker Mela 2018 — Top 30 Finalist

Selected among top hardware makers across Asia (Mumbai)

⭐

SleepX is a smart neck pillow designed for long-distance travelers. It integrates wireless Bluetooth-enabled earphones powered by a high-capacity Li-ion battery, allowing the device to run for more than 3 full days (72+ hours) on a single charge. It features a precision white LED at the bottom right, angled specifically to make reading books easy and comfortable at night without disturbing neighbors. Once connected to a smartphone via Bluetooth, users can control volume, skip tracks, attend calls, and invoke voice assistants hands-free.

2. Product Features & Engineering

✨ Look Elegant

Finely crafted for elegant look and feel so users can wear it for prolonged durations without fatigue. Handcrafted from fine rexine for comfort and filled with smooth, lightweight polyester fiber. The outer rexine enables easy cleaning with water while shielding sensitive internal electronic circuitry from moisture.

🔋 Run All Day Long

Powered by an internal 2,750mAh Lithium-Ion battery, SleepX runs for more than 3 days on a single charge. Travelers never have to worry about running out of battery during multi-day journeys. Equipped with a standard Micro-USB 2.0 port, it charges effortlessly with standard smartphone chargers or power banks.

🎧 Let's Go Wireless

Inbuilt Bluetooth earphones make listening more comfortable than ever before. Powered by Bluetooth 4.0, ultra-clear audio is streamed seamlessly. The pillow is equipped with tactile buttons to adjust volume, skip tracks, and answer incoming calls with an internal noise-isolated mic.

💡 Isn't it Beautiful at Night?

Ever wished to read books at night while traveling? SleepX makes the dream come true. Equipped with a focused white LED held by a finely engineered optical LED holder that illuminates reading materials at a comfortable 45° angle while allowing easy bulb or color tone replacement.

🎙️ And the Best Part...? Voice Control!

Control everything by voice! Users can invoke Google Assistant on Android or Siri on iOS directly via the pillow's microphone and headset controls. Travelers never need to fumble for their phone in crowded buses or trains—just speak the magic words to play music, check arrival times, or dictate messages.

title: GMADB — Graphical Minimal ADB & Fastboot
description: Open-source graphical tool for Android Debug Bridge (ADB), streamlining 1-click ROM/kernel flashing, device discovery, live output terminal blackboard, and shell execution.
content:
GMADB (GUI Minimal ADB) is an open-source Windows desktop application built with C# and .NET to streamline the workflow of flashing custom ROMs, kernels, recovery partitions, and sideloading packages to Android devices over the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) and Fastboot protocols.

1. The Problem Space

Flashing custom firmware (LineageOS, Pixel Experience, TWRP, Magisk root packages) traditionally requires users to open command prompts, manually navigate complex filesystem paths, type exact terminal arguments (adb sideload rom.zip, fastboot flash recovery twrp.img), and monitor cryptic CLI error strings. A single typo can leave a device soft-bricked or stuck in bootloops.

2. Architecture & Functional Breakdown

1. Select & Single-Click Flash Engine

Users click Select ROM, choose their target .zip or .img package via the native file explorer dialog, and click Flash. GMADB automatically validates package file integrity, checks whether the connected device is in ADB Recovery or Fastboot bootloader mode, and dispatches the exact sequence of flashing commands.

2. Live Asynchronous Terminal Blackboard

Instead of hiding terminal logs or blocking the UI thread during large 2GB+ firmware transfers, GMADB spawns child ADB worker threads with asynchronous standard output (stdout) and standard error (stderr) stream redirection, piping real-time transfer percentages and error diagnostics to a styled terminal window.

3. Automated Device Discovery

A single click queries adb devices and fastboot devices, parsing hardware serial numbers, device model names, and connection states (Device, Recovery, Sideload, Unauthorized).

4. Custom Shell Execution & Activity Logging

Advanced developers can send raw shell commands (e.g. adb shell getprop ro.product.model, adb reboot recovery) directly from the integrated input console while automatic log recorders output timestamped session diagnostics for debugging failed flashes.

3. Tech Stack & Dependencies

C#, .NET Framework 4.5+, Windows Forms, Android Debug Bridge (ADB), Fastboot CLI Engine

title: DOS_GUI — Graphical Windowing System for MS-DOS
description: Custom graphical user interface built from scratch in Turbo C++ for MS-DOS environments, exploring low-level Cartesian coordinate rasterization and event polling with graphics.h.
content:
DOS_GUI (originally titled DOS Ultimate) is a complete graphical windowing environment written in pure Turbo C++ for MS-DOS and DOSBox. Built in 2016 as a deep exploration of computer graphics fundamentals, the project implements window lifecycle management, mouse/keyboard event loops, mathematical rasterization, and interactive desktop utilities using only raw VGA raster primitives.

💡 Written to understand how early operating system pioneers built graphical interfaces before modern frameworks existed.

1. Visual Tour & Screenshots

1. BIOS-Style Boot Sequence

2. Encrypted User Authentication

3. Desktop Environment & App Launcher

4. Shutdown Confirmation Dialog

2. Architectural & Code Analysis

Under Turbo C++ running in 16-bit real-mode emulation, memory is strictly segmented into 64KB chunks and no windowing abstractions exist. The entire environment is built from first mathematical principles:

Cartesian Coordinate Window Drawing Engine

// Drawing a 3D beveled window with title bar and drop shadow
void drawWindow(int x, int y, int w, int h, char* title) {
    // 1. Drop shadow offset
    setfillstyle(SOLID_FILL, DARKGRAY);
    bar(x + 5, y + 5, x + w + 5, y + h + 5);
    
    // 2. Main Window Surface
    setfillstyle(SOLID_FILL, LIGHTGRAY);
    bar(x, y, x + w, y + h);
    
    // 3. Beveled 3D Borders
    setcolor(WHITE);
    line(x, y, x + w, y); // Top highlight
    line(x, y, x, y + h); // Left highlight
    setcolor(BLACK);
    line(x + w, y, x + w, y + h); // Right shadow
    line(x, y + h, x + w, y + h); // Bottom shadow
    
    // 4. Gradient Title Bar
    setfillstyle(SOLID_FILL, BLUE);
    bar(x + 2, y + 2, x + w - 2, y + 22);
    setcolor(WHITE);
    outtextxy(x + 10, y + 7, title);
}

Integrated Applications Suite

The codebase includes fully interactive built-in programs:

  • Conversational AI Assistant: Rule-based natural language parsing engine responding to system queries.
  • Geometry & Area Calculator: Interactive trigonometric solver and formula computation engine.
  • Unit Converter: Multi-metric distance, temperature, and weight conversion tool.
  • Student Marksheet Evaluator: Grade computation and report card generator.

3. Tech Stack & Environment

C++, Turbo C++ 3.0, MS-DOS, DOSBox Emulator, graphics.h / BGI (Borland Graphics Interface)

title: Android Sensor Data Collector — ML Telemetry Suite
description: High-frequency telemetry logging engine capturing real-time Accelerometer, Gyroscope, and GPS streams into structured CSV datasets for machine learning rash driving detection models.
content:
Android Sensor Data Collector is an open-source mobile telemetry logger designed to collect high-precision inertial and geospatial data streams from onboard smartphone sensors. The captured CSV datasets are structured specifically for training and validating machine learning models that detect aggressive driving behaviors, harsh braking, and vehicular collisions.

1. The Problem Space

Training supervised machine learning models to detect rash driving, sudden swerving, and abrupt deceleration requires thousands of hours of synchronized, clean, high-frequency motion data. However, existing telemetry tools were either closed-source, battery-draining, or failed to synchronize GPS coordinates with millisecond-accurate inertial sensor readings.

2. Technical Architecture & Sensor Pipeline

High-Frequency Sensor Polling

The application hooks into the Android SensorManager at SENSOR_DELAY_FASTEST / SENSOR_DELAY_GAME, registering asynchronous listeners for:

  • 3-Axis Accelerometer: Captures linear acceleration along X, Y, and Z axes (in $m/s^2$) including gravitational components.
  • 3-Axis Gyroscope: Measures rotational velocity (in $rad/s$) around all three spatial axes.
  • Fused Location Provider: Queries GPS and Wi-Fi triangulation for latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, and bearing.

Buffered CSV File I/O

To avoid I/O bottlenecks and frame drops on low-end Android handsets, sensor events are queued in an in-memory ring buffer. Worker threads flush buffered batches into a structured CSV file stored on internal device memory:

// CSV Format Schema:
// timestamp_ms, acc_x, acc_y, acc_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, lat, lng, speed, accuracy
1624891200123, 0.124, 9.812, 0.045, 0.001, -0.002, 0.004, 10.01234, 76.34567, 14.2, 3.5

3. Machine Learning Integration

The resulting datasets have been used to train Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests, and 1D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to classify driving events into: Normal Driving, Harsh Acceleration, Abrupt Braking, and Aggressive Lane Changing.

4. Tech Stack

Java, Android SDK (API 28+), SensorManager API, FusedLocationProviderClient, CSV File Stream Writer

title: Convivial — Enterprise Event Management Platform
description: Full-stack event administration dashboard and ticketing suite featuring tier-based pricing, purchase analytics, customer ticket booking, and real-time conversion metrics.
content:
Convivial is an enterprise-grade event management dashboard and ticketing administration platform. It enables event organizers to manage the entire event lifecycle: publishing multi-track events, configuring tiered ticket categories, processing customer ticket purchases, and inspecting real-time purchase analytics and venue capacity.

1. Architectural Breakdown

Convivial is structured with a clean separation of concerns between a reactive single-page frontend and a high-performance RESTful API backend.

Frontend Layer (Vue 3 + Vuex + Vuesax)

  • Vue 3 Composition API: Modular components for event listing, ticket category builders, and attendee management.
  • Vuex State Management: Global state store handling token-based session persistence, reactive shopping cart state, and live analytics updates.
  • Axios HTTP Interceptors: Handles automatic Bearer token injection, request throttling, and global error handling.
  • Vuesax Design System: Custom styled cards, dialogs, and responsive navigation drawers.

Backend Layer (Laravel 8 Sanctum + MySQL)

  • Laravel 8 MVC Architecture: RESTful API controllers with validated Form Requests and Eloquent ORM relationships.
  • Sanctum Authentication: Lightweight API token authentication ensuring secure multi-role access (Admin, Organizer, Cashier).
  • Transaction Safety: Database transactions wrapping ticket booking and seat allotment routines to prevent overselling.

2. Key Capabilities

  • 🎟️ Tiered Ticketing Engine: Configure VIP, Early Bird, General Admission, and Student tiers with dynamic cutoff dates and seat quotas.
  • 📊 Live Sales Analytics: Visual representation of revenue velocity, hourly checkout rates, and category distribution.
  • 👥 Direct Customer Sideloading: Administrative ticket generation on behalf of cash/offline buyers with instant QR voucher generation.

3. Tech Stack

Vue 3, Vuex, Vuesax, Laravel 8, PHP 8, Sanctum, MySQL, Axios
